subject.title: fix(doctor): recover sibling moltbot.json config dropped on upgrade (#54200) [AI-assisted]

question: Should OpenClaw accept bounded `openclaw doctor --fix` recovery for sibling `.openclaw/moltbot.json` after the filename was retired?
rationale: The implementation is a narrow fix for a valid upgrade regression, but it intentionally restores a retired config filename through doctor repair and can replace skeletal canonical config with credential-bearing legacy content.

options.title: Land Scoped Doctor Recovery
options.body: Accept the compatibility exception because recovery stays in doctor/startup guidance, runtime config resolution remains canonical, and the PR includes backup, restore, chmod, no-clobber coverage, and terminal proof.

options.title: Require Fix Mode For Every Write

options.title: Decline Retired Filename Recovery
